label: start
name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All nine trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and their training success was also 0. That held for local footprint heads, per-layer heads, flat Linear heads (which can learn any mapping from actions to cells), cheap and expensive networks, and 1 to 4 epochs. Since the flat head failed too, a twist in the action indexing alone is unlikely to explain it. A permutation of observation channels is also unlikely, because the generic 1x1 stems would cope with it. The most likely common cause is that the policy collapses early. A random placement usually earns a negative reward because it fills cells outside the target. DONE, a single action that ends the episode, then looks better than the average placement, so PPO with lr 1e-3 and low entropy (0.005 in most trials) may lock into pressing DONE early. The greedy evaluation would then build nothing. With the last 3 trials, I am testing stability and exploration: lower lr, higher entropy and a longer horizon. I am also trying a network that sees the action mask.
